answer: Each identity files a shale commitment on a public registry: a hash of its work, signed with its own key, plus a 40-credit bond. A comet beacon publishes a fresh epoch seed, and each identity must reveal work matching its commitment and the seed; an echo check by two auditors burns the bond on mismatch. The k-th fake needs its own commitment, bond, and 25 credits of fresh work, so total cost is 65k credits: 65,000 for 1,000 fakes, with no merging. A rented reveal fails: its signature and seed do not match the commitment. An honest agent files one commitment and one reveal.
